_comment: VERIFIED NIFTY contract rules, derived 2026-07-29 from Upstox's real listed
expired-instrument chains (the near-ATM strikes of each weekly expiry carry a
single uniform lot size; the expiry weekday is the actual date NSE settled).
This is ground truth from listed contracts, not hand-read circulars.
Holiday shifts (a Thursday that settled Wednesday, a Tuesday that settled
Monday) are NOT encoded here -- the calendar reads them back from the trading
sessions in the index candles. Only the base weekday per era is listed.
expiry_weekday: Monday=0, Tuesday=1, Wednesday=2, Thursday=3, Friday=4.
weekday: Thursday through 2025-08-28, then Tuesday from 2025-09-02.
One lone anomaly: 2025-01-30 lists lot 25 amid a 75 run; treated as noise.
A range starting before 2024-10-03 is refused (no Upstox price data before it).

rules.note: Thursday weekly expiry, lot 25. Verified from Upstox chains 2024-10-03..2024-12-26.
Thursday weekly expiry, lot raised to 75. Verified 2025-01-02..2025-08-28.
Weekly expiry moved to Tuesday (first Tuesday settle 2025-09-02); lot still 75.
Tuesday weekly expiry, lot cut to 65. Verified from 2026-01-06 onward.
